prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production motion sprite sheet extending the attached ADOPTED salaryman sprite; this is NOT a redesign. Input image is the exact approved 48x56 RGBA sprite shown at nearest 8x. Preserve his identical square short dark hair, broad angular middle-aged Japanese face, opaque foggy pale glasses hiding the eyes, thin arms/legs, protruding pot belly, blue-gray open suit, cream shirt, muted burgundy tie and dark shoes. Side/three-quarter facing RIGHT in every cell. Same small pixel clusters, muted palette, brown one-pixel contour, top-left light, no soft illustration or new facial details.
Transparent background. Exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 8 isolated full-body sprites with ample transparent gutters. Same scale, camera, head silhouette and baseline in every cell. No labels, lines, shadows, props, text or extra characters. Each sprite should read as a native ~40 pixel tall body enlarged into the output; use clean chunky square pixels.
Row 1: four distinct alternating WALK cycle keyframes: (0) near leg extended forward with heel grounded, far leg back, opposite arms; (1) weight down, far foot passing lifted, bent knees; (2) far leg extended forward grounded, near leg back, opposite arms reversed; (3) near foot passing lifted, weight returns. Both feet must not stay identical between frames. No running leaps. Keep the upper body recognizable and potbelly, thin limbs.
Row 2: (4) HURT short backward recoil, shoulders flinch and arms raised protectively, knees bent, feet still on ground, no injury/blood; (5) HURT recovery braced with one hand at belly, same face; (6) RETREAT brisk nervous escape step with near leg forward, arms tucked protectively, body leans RIGHT; (7) RETREAT opposite leg forward, same lean and upper body. Alive, not falling or corpse. Retreat direction is right; game mirrors when left is needed.
Keep head from the input visually unchanged. Do not make him cute, heroic, fat-limbed, young or muscular. Do not add a phone to these poses. Output only the requested 8-pose sheet.
